compiled_state.title: T4 GREEN: Implement bounded retry loop in _phase_remediate with state persistence
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Refactor _phase_remediate() in plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh to replace the flat single-pass 4-tier loop with a bounded retry loop. All T3 RED markers must be removed from .test-index after this task.

## Implementation requirements

### Counter state (local variables)
- _attempts_t1=0, _attempts_t2=0, _attempts_t3=0, _attempts_t4=0 (per-tier attempt counts)
- _attempts_global=0 (total attempts across all tiers)
- _prev_tier_files='' (for oscillation detection — files touched in previous attempt)
- _tiers_attempted='' (CSV of tier numbers tried, for escalation JSON)

### Outer loop structure
Replace the current 'for _tier in 1 2 3 4' with a loop that:
1. Checks _remediate_counter_increment before dispatching each tier attempt
2. On TIER_CEILING: calls _remediate_emit_escalation with stop_reason=TIER_CEILING, returns 2
3. On GLOBAL_CEILING: calls _remediate_emit_escalation with stop_reason=GLOBAL_CEILING, returns 2
4. On REGRESSION:N signal: resets that tier's counter to 0 (without exceeding global ceiling)
5. Persists state via _state_write_remediation_state after each increment

### Budget-pressure injection
- When tier attempt count reaches 4 (attempt 4 of 5), pass _attempt_num=4 to _dispatch_fix_agent
- Other attempts: pass current attempt count

### CANNOT_PROCEED detection
- When _dispatch_fix_agent returns 2 (ESCALATE): emit escalation JSON with stop_reason=CANNOT_PROCEED, return 2

### Oscillation detection
- After each successful dispatch (return 0), extract touched files from normalized findings
- If attempt >= 2 and files == _prev_tier_files: dispatch oscillation check via _OSCILLATION_CHECK_CMD (default: '.claude/scripts/dso oscillation-check') and emit stop_reason=OSCILLATION, return 2
- Update _prev_tier_files after each attempt

### State persistence
- Call _state_write_remediation_state with current phase='remediate', attempts_per_tier as JSON obj, _attempts_global
- Write after each counter increment

### Escalation JSON
- All exits via return 2 must call _remediate_emit_escalation before returning
- THROTTLE_PAUSE: emitted when MAX_AGENTS=0 check (check-usage.sh) returns pause before dispatch
- ARTIFACT_MISSING: emitted when all 4 tiers return exit 3 (all artifacts missing) on first pass

### Exit codes
- return 0: successful fix (CI passed on re-poll)
- return 2: any exhaustion or escalation (TIER_CEILING, GLOBAL_CEILING, CANNOT_PROCEED, OSCILLATION, THROTTLE_PAUSE, CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_FAILED, ARTIFACT_MISSING)
- Note: return 1 is NOT used by _phase_remediate (only by pre-remediation callers)

### Callers (audit required)
- merge-to-main-pr.sh line ~1198 calls _phase_remediate and does 'exit 2' on failure
- Audit merge-to-main.sh dispatcher for exit code 2 handling
- Audit sprint SKILL.md and COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md for any branching on exit code

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (_phase_remediate, possibly caller sites)
- .test-index (remove T3 RED markers)

## Files to audit (read-only unless changes needed)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh (exit code audit)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh (exit code audit)

## Acceptance criteria
- must: all T3 RED test functions now pass
- must: all T3 RED markers removed from .test-index
- must: no existing tests broken
- must: _phase_remediate exits 2 (not 1) on any exhaustion path
- must: escalation JSON emitted to stdout before returning 2
- must: state file contains remediation_attempts_per_tier, remediation_attempts_global, remediation_phase
